This repository is a collection of diagnostic scripts, deployment manifests, benchmarking tools, and AI-driven skills (Claude Code SKILL.md files) for operating and troubleshooting llm-d deployments. It contains: (1) preflight-checks — a Python script that collects GPU topology, environment variables, and system info before vLLM starts, with an optional pause mode for manual pod inspection; (2) networking-tests — Python scripts for validating GPU topology and inter-pod network performance using perftest, iperf3, NCCL/RCCL, and nixlbench; (3) NIXL deployment manifests (client/server pods with and without RoCE RDMA) and benchmarking scripts; (4) NIXL installer scripts. The Makefile includes kubebuilder scaffolding (controller-gen, kustomize, CRD targets) but no Go source code, cmd/ directory, or config/ directory actually exists — the operator scaffolding appears to be residual boilerplate. The project does not fit operator, library, service, or configuration categories cleanly; it is best described as an operational utilities toolkit for diagnosing, benchmarking, and managing llm-d preflight/decode (P/D) disaggregated inference environments.
